about: Which line of a government's own budgeted revenue a law carries, so a member weighing a bill can read what the change takes out of the budget (budget-stakes.ts, revenueGivenUp). A question's entry names the answer that ends the tax; a series' entry is a rate whose cut gives up the same share of its line. Line names are the budget's own (data/research/money/public-budget-bases.json and federal-budget-fy2025.json). A tax with no entry has no line of its own in the budgets.
